title: Spatial Transcriptomics in Thyroid Cancer: A PRISMA-Style Systematic Review of Platforms, Architecture, and Clinical Applications.
snippet: Thyroid cancer spans indolent differentiated tumors to lethal poorly differentiated and anaplastic carcinomas, and histopathology and molecular testing do not capture the spatial organization of tumor, stromal, and immune compartments that underlies invasion, dedifferentiation, and treatment resistance.
